item: PubMed XML parser with provenance and retraction classes (S07-01 S1)
summary: Pure-Python defusedxml streaming parser of PubmedArticleSet (bulk files and efetch share it). Provenance retracted/preprint/journal and notice kind read from the record; status links kept; gaps stay gaps (no abstract None, free-text date kept as text, bad PMID skipped and counted, cited ids never taken). No network, schema or re-extraction. Remains: store, consent-gated fetch (R745 corpus-driven keep), surface, freshness block; patents untouched.
